# Hồ Ngọc Thiện (ThienHN) - Personal Portfolio & Technical Profile

> Hồ Ngọc Thiện (commonly known as ThienHN) is a Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in modern web application development, performance optimization, scalable architecture, and user experience.

## 👤 Profile Summary
- **Full Name**: Hồ Ngọc Thiện (ThienHN / Ho Ngoc Thien)
- **Role**: Full Stack Software Engineer
- **Core Specialization**: Frontend (Vue 3, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SCSS), Backend (Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, Database Design), Web Performance & GEO/SEO Optimization.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/ThienHN0910

## 🛠️ Main Tech Stack & Skills
- **Frontend**: Vue 3, React.js, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router, Tailwind CSS, SCSS, Glassmorphic UI/UX Design.
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express, REST API design, MongoDB, Authentication & Authorization.
- **DevOps & Tools**: Git, Vercel, Cloudinary, CI/CD pipelines, Performance auditing (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
